meta.title: Murderers VS Sheriffs death effects
meta.coverageDecision: Rows are limited to exact-universe official developer products whose names clearly identify them as Effect, Kill Effect, or Death Effect cosmetics. MVS community value-list candidates are excluded until their source route or exact item existence is verified beyond the values endpoint.

sources.label: Official Roblox games API - universe 7219654364
sources.usage: Exact game identity, creator group, root place, and universe confirmation.

sources.label: Official Roblox developer-products API page 1 - universe 7219654364
sources.usage: Exact-universe effect product names, Robux prices, sale state, timestamps, and icon asset IDs where present.

sources.label: Official Roblox developer-products API page 2 - universe 7219654364
sources.usage: Additional exact-universe effect products after the first-page cursor.

sources.label: Official Roblox thumbnails API for effect icons
sources.usage: Official thumbnail image URLs for the six effect products with usable icon asset IDs.

sources.label: Official Roblox virtual-events API - universe 7219654364
sources.usage: Category evidence that the Summer event reward pool includes death effects. No event death-effect names were added from this source.

sourceNotes: Every public row in this file is backed by an official developer product in exact universe 7219654364.
Rows with IconImageAssetId 0 intentionally leave image blank and use imageMissingReason instead of weak substitutes.
The official Summer event mentions death effects as a reward category, but no unnamed Summer event effects are included.

The MVS community values endpoint includes effect-like entries such as batstorm, ghosted, pumpkin-curse, and soul-reaper, but those rows are excluded until source route or exact item existence is verified beyond the value endpoint.
Wrong-universe MVS, MVS2, and RED21 sources are excluded.

excludedCandidates.reason: Not included in public rows because Phase 2 approval required source route or exact item existence beyond the values endpoint.
The event confirms death effects as a reward category but does not name exact death-effect items.

imageCoverage.decision: Use official Roblox thumbnails for rows with nonzero icon assets; leave other image fields empty until in-game captures or official icons are available.
